description: This file defines the class dm_scan_result_t, which manages Wi-Fi scan result data, including initialization, encoding/decoding JSON, parsing IDs, comparison, and processing scan results.

classes.name: dm_scan_result_t
classes.description: Class encapsulating Wi-Fi scan result data, providing methods for initialization, JSON encoding/decoding, ID parsing, comparison, and conversion from raw scan data.

methods.name: int init()
methods.description: Initializes the scan result structure by zeroing out its memory.

methods.name: em_scan_result_t * get_scan_result()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal em_scan_result_t structure containing the scan data.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object into the scan result, associating it with a parent ID.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the scan result into a cJSON object.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Compares two dm_scan_result_t objects for equality.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns one dm_scan_result_t object to another.

methods.name: parse_scan_result_id_from_key
methods.description: Extracts a scan result ID and optional BSSID from a key string.

methods.name: has_same_id
methods.description: Checks if the scan result's ID matches a given ID.

methods.name: dm_scan_result_t (constructor with em_scan_result_t)
methods.description: Initializes the object from an existing em_scan_result_t.

methods.name: dm_scan_result_t (copy constructor)
methods.description: Creates a new object as a copy of an existing dm_scan_result_t.
